category.name: Web analytics
category.description: Website traffic, acquisition, conversion and visitor behavior measurement.
category.audience: Website owners and marketing, product and growth teams across industries.
category.audienceRationale: Relevant to organizations with websites or digital products; specialist staff often operate the tools.

pricing.note: Enterprise edition; contact sales. Standard Google Analytics is free and must not be presented as a paid subscription.

oss.name: PostHog core
locked: Paid-plan features are Cloud-only per self-host documentation
Platform packages reserve high-frequency/real-time alerts and white labeling
Platform packages reserve SAML, RBAC and property access controls
oss.classificationReason: MIT applies outside ee/ and third-party exceptions; ee/ has a separate license. Self-host documentation limits deployment to free-plan functions; packages include daily alert and branding gates as well as enterprise controls. Officially unsupported self-host; no application release cadence guarantee.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Traffic and events require replacing tracking instrumentation; no feature flags or experimentation assignment engine. Anonymous cross-device users are separate unless identified.

Core covers traffic, events and ecommerce; configure own tracker and tags. Premium features require separately licensed plugins; Google advertising attribution/integrations are not assumed equivalent.

Simpler traffic and conversion reporting with different tracking/privacy model; CE excludes richer funnel, journey and ecommerce revenue analysis. Not an enterprise Google advertising stack replacement.
Product-oriented analytics and instrumentation differ from Google Analytics 360. Self-host requires substantial infrastructure ownership; no supported self-host guarantees or paid-plan features.

uncertainties: No numeric public Analytics 360 entry price verified; quote required. Standard GA4 is free.
